OpenAI: Public Milestones Seed Timeline

A small official-source seed timeline. It is a starting point for reviewed expansion, not a comprehensive history.

  1. 2015-12-11
    verifiedhigh confidence

    OpenAI is introduced

    OpenAI published its introductory announcement and described itself as a nonprofit artificial intelligence research company.

    Interpretation: This is an appropriate public starting point for a timeline about OpenAI's institutional history.

    Sources

    • Introducing OpenAI OpenAI · primary · accessed 2026-06-01
  2. 2020-06-11
    verifiedhigh confidence

    OpenAI API launches in private beta

    OpenAI announced a private beta API for accessing new AI models through a general-purpose text-in, text-out interface.

    Interpretation: This milestone marks an early public path from model research toward developer-facing infrastructure.

    Sources

    • OpenAI API OpenAI · primary · accessed 2026-06-01
  3. 2021-01-05
    verifiedhigh confidence

    DALL-E is announced

    OpenAI announced DALL-E, a neural network trained to create images from text captions.

    Interpretation: The announcement broadens the public timeline beyond language output into text-guided image generation.

    Sources

    • DALL-E: Creating images from text OpenAI · primary · accessed 2026-06-01
  4. 2022-11-30
    verifiedhigh confidence

    ChatGPT launches publicly

    OpenAI opened ChatGPT to public feedback as a research preview.

    Interpretation: The public launch of ChatGPT is a major product milestone and a useful anchor for later product changes.

    Sources

    • Introducing ChatGPT OpenAI · primary · accessed 2026-06-01
  5. 2023-03-14
    verifiedhigh confidence

    GPT-4 is announced

    OpenAI announced GPT-4 and described it as a large multimodal model accepting image and text inputs and emitting text outputs.

    Interpretation: This milestone documents a major model-generation change after ChatGPT's public launch.

    Sources

    • GPT-4 OpenAI · primary · accessed 2026-06-01
  6. 2023-03-23
    verifiedhigh confidence

    ChatGPT plugins enter alpha rollout

    OpenAI announced initial support for ChatGPT plugins and began extending alpha access to users and developers from a waitlist.

    Interpretation: This milestone is useful for tracing how tool access and third-party integrations developed over time, including later deprecation.

    Sources

    • ChatGPT plugins OpenAI · primary · accessed 2026-06-01
  7. 2023-11-06
    verifiedhigh confidence

    DevDay introduces GPT-4 Turbo and Assistants API

    OpenAI announced GPT-4 Turbo, the Assistants API, and additional multimodal developer-platform capabilities at DevDay.

    Interpretation: This event captures a substantial expansion of the developer platform after the initial API beta.

    Sources

    • New models and developer products announced at DevDay OpenAI · primary · accessed 2026-06-01
  8. 2024-01-10
    verifiedhigh confidence

    GPT Store rollout begins

    OpenAI began rolling out the GPT Store to ChatGPT Plus, Team, and Enterprise users.

    Interpretation: This milestone documents a product-distribution layer for custom versions of ChatGPT.

    Sources

    • Introducing the GPT Store OpenAI · primary · accessed 2026-06-01
  9. 2024-05-13
    verifiedhigh confidence

    GPT-4o is introduced

    OpenAI introduced GPT-4o as a new flagship model and described improvements across text, voice, and vision.

    Interpretation: This is a later public product and model milestone that can be expanded with system-card evidence.

    Sources

    • Introducing GPT-4o and more tools to ChatGPT free users OpenAI · primary · accessed 2026-06-01
  10. 2024-09-12
    verifiedhigh confidence

    OpenAI o1-preview is released

    OpenAI released the first preview models in its o1 series in ChatGPT and the API, describing them as models designed to spend more time thinking before responding.

    Interpretation: This introduces a public reasoning-model branch in the product timeline.

    Sources

    • Introducing OpenAI o1-preview OpenAI · primary · accessed 2026-06-01
  11. 2024-10-31
    verifiedhigh confidence

    ChatGPT search is introduced

    OpenAI introduced ChatGPT search with web answers that include links to relevant sources, initially for ChatGPT Plus and Team users and SearchGPT waitlist users.

    Interpretation: This event is directly relevant to a timeline project concerned with source trails and current web information.
